narrative.overview:
makernik is one cream sheet drawn in charcoal, with copper as the only spot of color. The homepage is a paper map whose terrain is a maze. Graph paper sits only on the maze field, a square title plate of the same cream rests on that field, and a dense legend runs along its bottom edge. Below the fold the same sheet continues as ruled rows, a bin label, and empty photo mounts.

The sheet stays quiet. Titles are large, semibold, and tightly tracked. Reading text is Inter and holds to 65 characters. Regions meet at a hairline, and nothing lifts off the page. The maze is drawn in canvas once, then it rests. A missing photograph stays an empty mount labeled Photo needed.
keyCharacteristics: Cream sheet, charcoal ink, and copper as the only chromatic color
Square corners and hairline rules on a flat sheet
Graph paper only on the maze field
Space Grotesk for titles and Inter for text, both self-hosted

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only chromatic color. It fills the primary action, colors the second half of the wordmark, marks the maze start and exit, and appears on link hover and text selection. Cream, stone, and charcoal do the rest of the drawing.

rules.name: The Graticule Rule
rules.body: The 22px graph paper, a 1px charcoal line at 11% opacity on Field Cream, is painted only on the maze field.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk carries titles, the wordmark, the email, and the mount label. Inter carries reading text, navigation, buttons, legend facts, and bin labels. Both are self-hosted Latin cuts from @fontsource.

rules.name: The Semibold Title Rule
rules.body: Titles are weight 600 with -0.025em tracking and are not set in uppercase.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Content sits in one column no wider than 72rem, inset 1.25rem and 2rem from 768px. Sections stack on the same cream, separated by a 15% charcoal hairline, with 5rem of vertical padding and 7rem from 768px.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Depth is a hairline or one tonal step, Field Cream or Legend Stone. Surfaces do not cast shadows.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Plates, buttons, bin labels, mounts, and the header have square corners. The dashed stroke is reserved for an empty photo mount. The maze start mark stays a copper disc.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is a 2px outline, offset 3px on controls and 4px on text links. Filled copper buttons use Focus Copper. Every other control and link uses Spot Copper.

dos: Do keep Spot Copper at hsl(18 70% 36%) or darker when it is text or a filled button on Sheet Cream.
Do draw the maze in canvas, and keep a missing photograph as a dashed mount labeled "Photo needed".
Do load Space Grotesk and Inter from the self-hosted @fontsource files.
Do keep plates, buttons, bins, mounts, and the header square, and separate regions with a 1px charcoal rule.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic color.
Don't paint the graph-paper graticule outside the maze field.
Don't round plates, buttons, bins, or mounts.
Don't lift a surface with a drop shadow.
Don't set an action in uppercase tracked micro-type.
Don't fill an empty mount with a generated, stock, or sample image.
